scenarios.name: Collapse descendants of the Origin folder

scenario_steps.name: an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software
the Origin folder is expanded with its planes, axes and center point visible as rows
the user right-clicks the Origin folder
its context menu offers Expand All Children and collapses All Children
the user chooses Collapse All Children
the Origin folder remains expanded with its direct reference rows visible
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
the user clicks the Origin expansion control
the reference rows are hidden and the Origin folder remains visible
the user clicks the Origin expansion control again
the reference rows are visible again
